question: Compare net revenue in Germany versus France

answer_sql:
SELECT
  c.country_name AS country,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON s.sale_country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  c.country_name IN ('Germany', 'France')
GROUP BY
  c.country_name
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
